securitySettings.heading: Security
securitySettings.intro: How long sessions last and the limits on failed logins, for the whole installation.
securitySettings.sourceEnvironment: Initial values, from the server's configuration. From the first save, the values saved here apply.

session_idle_days.label: Days without use
session_idle_days.hint: 1 to 30. A session not used for this long ends. Applies at once, also to open sessions.

session_absolute_days.label: Days after login
session_absolute_days.hint: 1 to 90. A session ends after this long in any case. A shorter value also applies to open sessions, except this one.

login_account_failures.label: Attempts per user before a block
login_account_failures.hint: 3 to 20 wrong passwords in a row.

login_address_failures.label: Attempts per address before a block
login_address_failures.hint: 10 to 200, at least twice those per user. People on the same network share one address.

block_first_minutes.label: First block (minutes)
block_first_minutes.hint: 1 to 15. It doubles at each further failed attempt.

block_max_minutes.label: Longest block (minutes)
block_max_minutes.hint: 15 to 120. A long block slows guessing, but someone failing on purpose keeps a user blocked for longer.

errors.idleOverAbsolute: It cannot be more than the days after login ({{max}}).
errors.addressUnderAccount: It must be at least twice the attempts per user (at least {{min}}).

securitySettings.everyone: Require two-factor sign-in for every user
securitySettings.everyoneHint: Users who have not turned it on yet: {{count}}. At their next visit they must set it up before anything else. Someone who loses the phone and the recovery codes asks an administrator.
